Wear it, pin it, sew it

Small details with a nugget connection. Materials matter: gold-colored plastic, plating, and real gold are different things.

  • ◇

    Gold-colored material

    Gold Nugget Plastic Sewing Buttons

    Nugget-textured shank buttons can add a little prospector character to a sewing project. They look metallic but the seller identifies the material as plastic.

    Material / ingredients: Gold-colored plastic; shank-back sewing buttons. Not natural gold or solid metal.

    Offered when checked. The seller’s dozen-button listing showed quantity selection and Add to Cart when checked. Check the selected size and seller’s current terms.

    View seller’s nugget buttons ↗

    Last checked Nov 3, 2026

    Sources & details
    • etsy.com ↗Checked Nov 3, 2026. Seller OneStopStitched identifies plastic material and shank construction and offers the dozen-button listing with quantity selection. Automated image captions suggesting metal were not used as material evidence.
  • ◇

    Real natural gold nugget with sterling silver

    Placer Gold Design Nugget, Pick and Shovel Lapel Pin

    A pick-and-shovel pin carries an actual nugget from Atlin, British Columbia. This offers a genuine-gold contrast to costume nugget pins.

    Material / ingredients: Maker specifies a natural gold nugget and solid sterling silver; the entire pin is not solid gold.

    Offered when checked. The pin was available when checked. Each natural nugget differs; confirm the piece you’ll receive with the maker.

    View maker’s natural-nugget pin ↗

    Last checked Nov 3, 2026

    Sources & details
    • shop.placergolddesign.com ↗Checked Nov 3, 2026. Maker identifies solid sterling silver, a natural Atlin gold nugget and Canadian manufacture.
    • shop.placergolddesign.com ↗Checked Nov 3, 2026. Live public product metadata reports the pin available=true.
  • ◇

    Gold plating over another metal

    Agatha Gold Nugget Charm Pendant

    A nugget-shaped charm gives the look of a little find without pretending to be a mined nugget. The maker identifies the underlying metal and gold finish separately.

    Material / ingredients: Pewter gilded with 18-karat gold; a manufactured nugget-shaped charm, not solid gold.

    Offered when checked. The maker’s product page offers Add to Cart. Chains and other styling pieces are separate selections; check delivery availability for your country.

    View maker’s plated nugget charm ↗

    Last checked Nov 3, 2026

    Sources & details
    • agathaparis.com ↗Checked Nov 3, 2026. Maker explicitly specifies nugget-shaped pewter gilded with 18k gold (750/1000 gold-plated pewter) and an active order control.

A little gold around the house

A recognizable bullion or nugget shape earns its place here; a gold-colored everyday object alone does not.

  • ▧

    Gold-colored textile; three-dimensional bar shape

    Gold Bar Pillow

    A small, three-dimensional bullion-bar cushion turns sofa treasure into something softer. It is a shaped bar pillow, distinct from a square cushion printed with a gold-bar picture.

    Material / ingredients: Polyester cover according to the seller; gold-colored fabric, not gold metal.

    Offered when checked. The retailer marked it in stock when checked. Listed dimensions are 28 × 15.5 × 9 cm; confirm shipping and the supplied product before ordering.

    View retailer’s gold-bar pillow ↗

    Last checked Nov 3, 2026

    Sources & details
    • costumepartyworld.com ↗Checked Nov 3, 2026. Retailer lists a polyester-covered pillow, 28 × 15.5 × 9 cm, and In Stock; live structured availability metadata also reports InStock. This is a bullion-bar product, not the unverified irregular nugget-cushion concept.
  • ▧

    Gold-plated hardware when a gold finish is selected

    P.E. Guerin Nugget Cabinet Knob No. 70040

    A textured cabinet knob brings a nugget-like surface to furniture. Choose a gold finish for the treasure effect or explore the maker’s other finishes.

    Material / ingredients: The maker’s Polished Gold and Antique Gold finishes use 24-karat gold plating over brass. Other finishes have different compositions.

    Maker / seller listing. The maker lists No. 70040 in its Stock product line, with finish selection and Request Price. Finish availability, lead time and pricing require a quote; the default photo shows Pewter.

    View maker’s nugget knob and request a quote ↗

    Last checked Nov 3, 2026

    Sources & details

    • peguerin.com ↗Checked Nov 3, 2026. Maker’s Nugget collection describes Antique Gold as a finish for a gold-nugget look.

Pocket treasures & oddities

Small gifts with a prospecting or treasure twist. These are outbound discoveries, not products sold by Gold Trails.

  • ◈

    Printed image; not real gold

    The Gold Mart Printed Gold Nuggets Keychain

    Carry a photograph of California nuggets on a light circular keychain. The treasure is the printed design, rather than a three-dimensional nugget or a real-gold charm.

    Material / ingredients: Printed aluminum circle with a metal key ring and plastic snap ring. Not a nugget-shaped object.

    Offered when checked. The designer’s Zazzle listing offers Add to Cart and several base styles. This description refers to the aluminum-circle option.

    View designer’s printed nugget keychain ↗

    Last checked Nov 3, 2026

    Sources & details
    • zazzle.com ↗Checked Nov 3, 2026. The Gold Mart listing offers the item; Zazzle specifies two-sided full-color printing on an aluminum circle. Nugget imagery is a print, not a natural-gold material claim.
ON THE WISH LIST

A nugget we haven’t found yet

A soft, irregular nugget-shaped pillow

Imagine a rounded, uneven cushion in metallic-gold fabric, shaped like a nugget you could rest your head on.

Original concept · No verified product listing

An original idea discussed for Gold Trails. An exact standalone product has not been confirmed, so this has no purchase link. A bar-shaped pillow or a square pillow bearing a nugget picture is a different object.

A few notes before following the trail

Gold Trails links out to the maker, seller, or operator. This collection is research, rather than hands-on product reviews. Listings, prices, menus, and stock can change; a source page does not guarantee checkout, shipping, or a place on today’s menu.

Materials and shapes are described as the source identifies them. Gold-colored materials and printed pictures do not establish real-gold content. A pillow shaped like a bar is different from an irregular nugget cushion.

For another kind of treasure, explore Gold Games. For real prospecting, start with our field articles, equipment catalog, or Clubs & Groups.
